description: Altri temi - Suolo e vegetazione - IFFI - Aree crolli, ribaltamenti, sprofondamenti e frane - Cartografie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arcgis.com. Lo strato cartografico delle aree soggette a crolli, ribaltamenti, sprofondamenti e frane, fa parte della cartografia dell'IFFI (Inventario dei Fenomeni Franosi in Italia), che fornisce un quadro sinottico ed omogeneo sulla distribuzione dei fenomeni franosi sull'intero territorio ragionale. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include n.d., Geology. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
